news.titleEn: Brent oil jumps more than 4% as U.S. reportedly sends third aircraft carrier to Middle East
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude jumped 4.4% to settle at $102.31 a barrel and WTI rose 2.7% to $92.87 after reports the U.S. is sending a third carrier strike group to the Middle East, on top of China suspending fuel exports for October.
news.conclusionZh: 美国增派第三艘航母叠加中国暂停燃油出口，布油涨4.4%至102美元
news.whyEn: Oil above $100 feeds straight into inflation, bond yields and central bank decisions worldwide, and hits airlines, shippers and consumers.
news.whyZh: 油价破百直接推高全球通胀与债券收益率，航空、航运和普通消费者首当其冲
news.detailEn: U.S. officials said the USS Theodore Roosevelt strike group and roughly 10,000 sailors and Marines are heading to the region, which could put three U.S. carriers there by the end of October. Separately, Beijing began its week-long national holiday without issuing October fuel export permits to major refiners, and PetroChina cancelled gasoline and jet fuel cargoes, tightening an already strained global diesel market. Traders are now watching whether China restores export quotas after the holiday ends on Oct. 7 and whether U.S.-Iran talks make progress.
news.detailZh: 美国官员称「罗斯福号」航母打击群及约1万名海军和陆战队员正开赴该地区，最早10月底中东将同时有三艘美国航母。与此同时，中国进入国庆长假前未向主要炼厂发放10月成品油出口许可，中石油取消了汽油和航煤出口船货，令本已紧张的全球柴油市场雪上加霜。市场接下来关注10月7日假期结束后中国是否恢复出口配额，以及美伊谈判能否取得进展。

news.titleEn: S&P 500 closes higher to start October as Treasury yields retreat from multiyear highs: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stocks edged higher on the first trading day of October (S&P 500 +0.19% to 7,666) after the 10-year Treasury yield briefly hit 5.34%, its highest since 2002, before retreating.
news.conclusionZh: 美债10年期收益率一度触及5.34%创2002年来新高，美股10月首日小涨
news.whyEn: The 10-year yield sets the price of mortgages and corporate borrowing; levels above 5% pressure housing, highly indebted firms and stock valuations.
news.whyZh: 10年期美债是房贷和企业融资的定价锚，5%以上会压制楼市、高负债企业和股市估值
news.detailEn: The yield spike came after the ISM manufacturing prices-paid index came in hotter than expected, reinforcing fears of sticky inflation driven by oil. Stocks clawed back early losses as yields eased, with the Dow up 20 points to 50,926 and the Nasdaq flat. All three major indexes remain on pace for weekly losses, and Friday's September jobs report is the next big test for rate expectations.
news.detailZh: 收益率飙升的导火索是ISM制造业物价支付指数高于预期，加剧了油价推动通胀黏性的担忧。随着收益率回落，美股收复早盘跌幅，道指涨20点至50926点，纳指持平。三大股指本周仍有望录得周跌幅，周五公布的9月非农就业数据将是利率预期的下一个关键考验。

news.titleEn: Anthropic Targets November IPO After Delays, Eyes SpaceX-Sized Debut
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic is seeking to go public as soon as mid-November, with formal marketing possibly starting the week of Nov. 9 and a target valuation of up to $2 trillion.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic拟最早11月中旬上市，目标估值最高2万亿美元
news.whyEn: At up to $2 trillion it would be the largest IPO ever, testing public-market appetite for AI and potentially reshaping index weightings.
news.whyZh: 若成行将是史上最大IPO，检验公开市场对AI的胃口，并可能改变指数权重格局
news.detailEn: Bloomberg reported that Anthropic, maker of the Claude models, pushed back its earlier listing plan but could now begin trading before Thanksgiving on Nov. 26. The company is set to meet prospective investors on Oct. 14, and the timing could still change. The deal would follow a wave of mega AI fundraising and comes as rival OpenAI also seeks new capital.
news.detailZh: 据彭博报道，Claude模型开发商Anthropic此前推迟了上市计划，如今有望在11月26日感恩节前挂牌交易。公司计划10月14日与潜在投资者会面，时间表仍可能调整。此次上市紧随一轮AI巨额融资潮，竞争对手OpenAI也在寻求新一轮融资。

news.titleEn: Live Updates: Trump says Iran "ready to fold up," after threatening post-midterm attacks
news.conclusionEn: Iran said it received an official U.S. response to its ceasefire proposal via Qatari mediators, even as Trump said heavier strikes after the Nov. 3 midterms were "possible" and more U.S. forces head to the region.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗收到美方停火回复，但特朗普称中期选举后可能加大打击
news.whyEn: Whether the Strait of Hormuz reopens is the single biggest swing factor for oil prices, global inflation and shipping.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡能否重开，是油价、全球通胀和航运的最大变量
news.detailEn: Tehran's proposal called for the U.S. to lift its blockade of Iranian ports in exchange for reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. Officials briefed on the talks say both sides largely agree on the steps needed but disagree on their sequencing. Meanwhile, Trump told Time magazine that intensifying strikes after the midterms was possible, keeping markets on edge over a war now in its seventh month.
news.detailZh: 伊朗方案要求美国解除对伊朗港口的封锁，换取伊朗在七天内重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。知情官员称，双方对需要采取的步骤基本一致，但在先后顺序上仍有分歧。与此同时，特朗普在接受《时代》杂志采访时表示中期选举后「有可能」加大打击力度，这场已持续七个月的战争仍让市场高度紧张。

news.titleEn: Inflation Jumps Across Euro Zone, Raising Pressure on ECB to Hike
news.conclusionEn: September inflation surged in the euro zone's biggest economies — France 3.4%, Italy 4.1%, Germany 3.3%, Spain 5.0% — on the Iran war energy shock.
news.conclusionZh: 欧元区主要经济体9月通胀全面跳升，西班牙达5%
news.whyEn: It raises the odds of a third ECB rate hike this year, lifting borrowing costs across Europe and affecting the euro.
news.whyZh: 欧央行年内第三次加息概率上升，将推高欧洲融资成本并影响欧元走势
news.detailEn: Energy and food inflation surprised to the upside in every country that has reported so far, with natural gas, petrol and diesel prices soaring. The ECB has already raised rates twice in 2026 and projected inflation of 3.6% in Q4, but economists now see the peak closer to 4%. Eurostat's bloc-wide flash estimate for September is due on Oct. 2.
news.detailZh: 已公布数据的国家中，能源和食品通胀全部超出预期，天然气、汽油和柴油价格大涨。欧央行2026年已加息两次，此前预计第四季度通胀为3.6%，但经济学家认为峰值可能接近4%。欧盟统计局将于10月2日公布欧元区9月通胀初值。

news.titleEn: September ISM Manufacturing PMI comes in slightly below expectations at 54.5
news.conclusionEn: The ISM manufacturing PMI dipped to 54.5 in September from 54.6, slightly below forecasts, but stayed in expansion for a ninth straight month while the prices index ran hot.
news.conclusionZh: 美国9月ISM制造业PMI为54.5，连续9个月扩张但价格分项偏热
news.whyEn: Strong activity plus rising input costs makes a Fed rate hike more likely and helped push Treasury yields to two-decade highs.
news.whyZh: 需求强劲叠加成本上涨，增加美联储加息可能，并推升美债收益率
news.detailEn: New orders rose to 55.3 and employment to 52.7, while production slowed to 56.7. Supplier deliveries stayed slow for a tenth month, and panelists cited pricing volatility, tariffs and the Iran war as top concerns. The hotter prices-paid reading is what briefly sent the 10-year yield to 5.34%.
news.detailZh: 新订单升至55.3，就业升至52.7，生产放缓至56.7。供应商交货连续第十个月偏慢，受访企业最担心价格波动、关税和伊朗战争。物价支付指数偏热，正是10年期美债收益率一度冲上5.34%的直接原因。

news.titleEn: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
news.conclusionEn: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its new frontier AI model aimed at coding, enterprise work and cyber defense, first rolling it out to vetted security defenders.
news.conclusionZh: 谷歌发布最强模型Gemini 4 Argon，先向安全防御者开放
news.whyEn: It escalates the frontier-model race with OpenAI and Anthropic and signals AI's growing role in finding and patching software vulnerabilities.
news.whyZh: 加剧与OpenAI、Anthropic的前沿模型竞争，凸显AI在漏洞发现修复中的作用
news.detailEn: Google says Argon can autonomously find, validate and patch critical software vulnerabilities, so it is first going to members of its Fairwind Program before broader release. Introductory pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, and the output limit expands to one million tokens. Bloomberg separately reported some internal employee skepticism about the model.
news.detailZh: 谷歌称Argon能自主发现、验证并修补关键软件漏洞，因此先开放给Fairwind计划成员，之后再大范围推出。首发定价为每百万输入token 2美元、输出10美元，输出上限扩大到100万token。彭博另报道称，谷歌内部有部分员工对该模型持怀疑态度。

news.titleEn: HPE Boosts Forecast, Gets $1.2 Billion Gear Order From Vultr
news.conclusionEn: Hewlett Packard Enterprise won a $1.2 billion order from cloud provider Vultr for AI servers built on AMD's Helios rack and raised its networking growth outlook.
news.conclusionZh: HPE获Vultr 12亿美元AI服务器订单并上调网络业务展望
news.whyEn: It is the first big order for AMD's Helios rack, a sign that AI infrastructure spending is broadening beyond Nvidia-based systems.
news.whyZh: 这是AMD Helios机架首个大单，说明AI基建支出正向英伟达以外扩散
news.detailEn: The systems, including HPE networking switches and software, will be deployed across Vultr's U.S. data centers for model training and inference. HPE lifted its fiscal 2027 networking revenue growth forecast to the high-teens to low-20% range from 14%-17%. Shares rose nearly 4%, and the CFO said AI demand is still in its early innings.
news.detailZh: 这批系统含HPE网络交换机和软件，将部署在Vultr美国数据中心，用于模型训练和推理。HPE将2027财年网络业务收入增速预期从14%-17%上调至17%-20%出头。股价上涨近4%，CFO表示AI需求仍处于「早期阶段」。

news.titleEn: Russia Expels Hungarian Diplomats in Tit-For-Tat Move
news.conclusionEn: Russia ordered a group of Hungarian diplomats to leave within two weeks, retaliating for Budapest's expulsion of 10 Russian diplomats last month.
news.conclusionZh: 俄罗斯驱逐匈牙利外交官，回击布达佩斯此前驱逐10名俄外交官
news.whyEn: It marks Hungary's sharp turn away from Moscow under new PM Péter Magyar, strengthening EU unity on Russia and Ukraine.
news.whyZh: 标志匈牙利新总理马扎尔治下明显疏远莫斯科，有利欧盟对俄立场统一
news.detailEn: Staff from Hungary's embassy in Moscow and consulates in St Petersburg and Kazan must leave. Under Viktor Orbán, who was voted out in April, Hungary kept close ties with Putin and often slowed EU sanctions. Budapest said it is not interested in escalating tensions, but the episode underlines the shift in one of the EU's most Russia-friendly capitals.
news.detailZh: 匈牙利驻莫斯科使馆及驻圣彼得堡、喀山总领馆的部分人员须离境。今年4月下台的欧尔班执政期间，匈牙利与普京关系密切，常拖慢欧盟制裁。布达佩斯表示无意让紧张局势升级，但此事凸显这个曾经最亲俄的欧盟国家已明显转向。

news.titleEn: Russian drone hits school in Ukraine’s Kyiv as Moscow presses air assault
news.conclusionEn: A Russian Shahed drone struck a school in Kyiv on Oct. 1; children were in shelters and the warhead did not explode, so no casualties were reported.
news.conclusionZh: 俄无人机击中基辅一所学校，弹头未爆，无人伤亡
news.whyEn: Russia's intensifying air campaign on cities and power grids heading into winter raises humanitarian stakes and pressure on Western air-defense support.
news.whyZh: 入冬前俄军加紧空袭城市和电网，人道风险上升，西方防空援助压力加大
news.detailEn: Police and rescuers carried the unexploded warhead out of the damaged building, which was left with a large hole in its facade. The strike is part of near-daily drone and missile attacks on the Ukrainian capital. Kyiv is pressing allies for more air-defense systems ahead of winter, when attacks on energy infrastructure typically peak.
news.detailZh: 警方和救援人员将未爆弹头从受损建筑中移出，学校外墙被炸出大洞。这是俄方对乌克兰首都几乎每日无人机和导弹袭击的一部分。冬季通常是能源设施遇袭高峰，基辅正敦促盟友在入冬前提供更多防空系统。

businessTips.explanationEn: The anchoring effect is a cognitive bias where people rely too heavily on the first number or piece of information they see when making a judgment. Later estimates get adjusted from that anchor, but usually not enough. Understanding it helps you set prices, negotiate and avoid being manipulated by someone else's opening figure.
businessTips.explanationZh: 锚定效应是一种认知偏差：人们做判断时会过度依赖最先看到的数字或信息，后续判断都以它为基准调整，但往往调整不足。理解它能帮你更好地定价、谈判，也能避免被对方的开价牵着走。
businessTips.exampleEn: A software company shows an $899 enterprise plan next to its $299 pro plan, so the pro plan feels like a bargain. In a salary negotiation, making the first reasonable-but-ambitious offer often pulls the final number in your direction.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家软件公司把899美元的企业版放在299美元的专业版旁边，专业版就显得很划算。谈薪时先抛出一个合理但偏高的数字，最终结果往往会被拉向你这边。

businessTips.explanationEn: Value-based pricing sets your price according to the value the customer receives, not your cost or hours spent. It is especially powerful for freelancers and small businesses whose work saves clients money or generates revenue. It forces you to understand the client's problem deeply and frees you from the ceiling of hourly billing.
businessTips.explanationZh: 价值定价是按照客户获得的价值来定价，而不是按你的成本或花费的时间。对于能帮客户省钱或赚钱的自由职业者和小生意来说尤其有效。它逼你深入理解客户的问题，也让你摆脱按小时收费的天花板。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelancer who rewrites an online store's checkout page might take 10 hours, but if it lifts conversion and adds $50,000 a year in sales, charging $5,000 is a fair deal for the client. Ask discovery questions like "What is this problem costing you now?" before quoting.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由职业者重做网店结账页面可能只花10小时，但如果转化率提升带来每年5万美元的额外销售，收费5000美元对客户来说依然很划算。报价前先问清「这个问题现在让你损失多少钱？」

businessTips.explanationEn: These terms describe the shape of a futures price curve. In backwardation, near-term contracts cost more than later ones, signalling a tight market where buyers pay up for immediate supply; in contango, later contracts cost more, usually reflecting ample supply and storage costs. The curve shape affects the returns of commodity ETFs, which must constantly roll from expiring contracts into later ones.
businessTips.explanationZh: 这两个词描述期货价格曲线的形态。现货升水（Backwardation）指近月合约比远月贵，说明市场供应紧张、买家愿为即时供货付溢价；期货升水（Contango）指远月更贵，通常反映供应充足和仓储成本。曲线形态会影响商品ETF的收益，因为它们需要不断把到期合约展期到更远月份。
businessTips.exampleEn: With Brent above $100 on war-related supply fears and China halting fuel exports, the oil curve is likely in steep backwardation, so oil ETFs earn a positive "roll yield". In a glut like 2020, deep contango made oil funds lose money even when spot prices recovered.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如今战争和中国暂停燃油出口导致布油破百，油价曲线大概率呈陡峭的现货升水，石油ETF展期时能获得正的展期收益。而在2020年供应过剩时，深度期货升水让石油基金即使在现货价格反弹时也在亏钱。
